compression_rule: This capability SHALL remain independently meaningful and SHALL NOT be reduced to a generic Observer label.
distinctive_invariant: Integrity challenge may bound or weaken a claim; it does not manufacture attribution or authenticity.
evidence_rule: Observer output SHALL remain evidence-bounded and SHALL NOT silently strengthen uncertainty, visibility, or claim status.
provenance_rule: Every material result SHALL remain attributable to Observer identity, operation identity, bound Room/revision/view, evidence references, applicable ceiling, and disposition.
purpose: Apply bounded artifact, media, authentication, attribution, and claimed-identity integrity pressure without manufacturing authenticity or attribution.
questions: Does the supplied artifact support its claimed identity?
What integrity or authentication pressure remains unresolved?
Does the available evidence support attribution, contradict it, or leave it unresolved?
